stories.text: 🪦 The eulogy is in: Purdy Good gets its send-off (19.40 pts short). Read it on the Death Watch tab, and bring tissues.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: 49er Faith-Fool vs Ramosverse. Playoff odds with a win / loss: 49er Faith-Fool 74% / 51%, Ramosverse 19% / 5.8%.
🎯 TWO WINS: 49er Faith-Fool: 76% playoff odds with 2 wins this week, 45% with none (now 67%).
🎤 BYE BYE BYE: Gibb it to Me Baby has 4 starters on bye this week (Collins, Olave, Likely and Purdy). Hope the bench is ready.
🔁 Trade that should have happened: Williams and Irving for Judkins and Collins back in Week 4 would have helped both Kyle Tucker and Gibb it to Me Baby.
🪓 DEATH WATCH: Mel's Mediocre Mob leads the chopping-block odds at 35%, with In My Fantasy Era next at 27%.
🎸 DEEP CUTS: Ramosverse is starting Douglas (10%) and Mitchell (14%) while Hall (96%) and Stroud (79%) sit. % = rostered across ESPN.
🛒 WAIVER WIRE MVP: Ramosverse's pickups have put 266.82 pts into its starting lineup this season, led by Stroud (73.12 pts) and McLaughlin (66.00 pts).
🤝 Rivalry week: The Mahomies leads Ruffing the Passer 4–2 all-time, and The Mahomies has won the last 2.
🏆 Title odds entering Week 8: Brock You Like a Hurricane 36%, Gibb it to Me Baby 16%, Claremont In Yo Stace! 14%.
🕰️ Hindsight swap: If TDsMaGee and Claremont In Yo Stace! had swapped Robinson and Williams for Strange and London back in Week 4, both would be ahead.
🗞️ Fresh off the wire: Ruffing the Passer added George Holani (RB, projected 4.61 pts), plus 2 more pickups.
📈 Ruffing the Passer was down to 22% against Gibb it to Me Baby — and won.
